patches.title: Dead Hare v1.5 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Monsters already removed from battle (e.g. killed by the Scimitar's instant
kill) no longer counterattack.

patches.title: Item/Magic Counter v1.2 (Dead Hare compatible version) by Leet Sketcher
desc: Monsters that counter one specific spell or item (SrBehemoth, FlameEater...)
no longer keep countering every attack after being hit by it.
Requires dead_hare.asm first.

patches.title: Zombie/Rippler v1.2, fix A + B by Leet Sketcher
desc: Rippler no longer swaps hidden statuses (Morph, Dog Block...). A target
freed from Zombie by Rippler is healed 1/8 of its max HP (like Revivify)
instead of staying alive at 0 HP.

patches.title: Imp's Retort v1.5 by Leet Sketcher
desc: An Imp Cyan whose Retort fails no longer counters every physical attack for
the rest of the battle; Retort is cleared after every Fight.

patches.title: Self Sneeze v2.0 by Leet Sketcher
desc: The Fake Mustache control link is cut when Relm jumps with Palidor or when
either side is removed from battle.

patches.title: Dead in the Air v2.4 by Leet Sketcher
desc: A Condemned character whose timer runs out mid-Jump gets Wound instead of
staying alive at 0 HP; items are restored after every battle ending; the
Esper +30% HP/MP bonus is computed correctly.

patches.title: Smoke and Mirrors v1.0 by Leet Sketcher
desc: A Muddled character's Smoke Bomb no longer removes the monsters (which won
the battle) instead of the party.

patches.title: Soul Saved v1.4, fix A by Leet Sketcher
desc: Soul Savers are immune to instant death, so X-Zone can no longer end the
Wrexsoul battle early.

patches.title: Morph Mayhem v1.2 by Leet Sketcher
desc: The Morph gauge no longer drains while Terra is asleep, stopped or frozen,
while someone uses Quick, or after she leaves battle.

patches.title: Rock Bottom v1.3 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Near Fatal is applied again when Petrify is cured on a character under 1/8
of max HP.

patches.title: Status Unknown v1.1 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Statuses with no outline color no longer display blank and hide other
statuses such as Life 3 or Float.

patches.title: Imp Skimp v1.4 by Leet Sketcher
desc: The Imp sprite follows the Imp status instead of the Imp spell (a missed
Imp no longer turns the target, a Runic-absorbed Imp no longer flashes Celes).

patches.title: Imp's Rage v1.1 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Rage and Dance can no longer be used while the character is an Imp.

patches.title: Imp's Call v1.1 by Leet Sketcher
desc: An Esper summon cancelled by Imp no longer uses up the summon for the battle.

patches.title: Shadow's Status v1.2 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Lasting statuses (Vanish, Float...) are removed from Shadow after the
Floating Continent so he doesn't carry them to the Colosseum.

patches.title: Stone Faced v1.2 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Petrified monsters no longer repeat their last attack after every turn.

patches.title: Stone Cold v1.2 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Petrify no longer blocks Revivify's healing, so a Petrified Zombie no longer
ends up at 0 HP once Petrify is cured.

patches.title: Killer Life 3 v1.4 by Leet Sketcher
desc: An Undead monster killed by an X-weapon instant kill no longer revives with
Life 3 only to die again.

patches.title: Zombie/Tapir v1.2, fix A by Leet Sketcher
desc: Tapir curing Zombie heals 1/8 of max HP instead of leaving the character
alive at 0 HP.

patches.title: Double Block v1.1 by Leet Sketcher
desc: A living character with a shield no longer blocks a Fenix Down twice.

patches.title: Chance Offering v1.0 by Leet Sketcher
desc: The Offering halves Dice/Fixed Dice damage like other weapons.

patches.title: Half Knife v1.1 by Leet Sketcher
desc: The Offering also halves the ValiantKnife's bonus damage.

patches.title: Bye Bye Breath v1.2 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Fixes two crashes in the second Phunbaba fight (a Charmed Phunbaba blowing a
member out of a full party, and an empty party after a lone KO).

patches.title: Off Death Row v1.2 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Safety Bit and Memento Ring clear Condemned when they save the character
instead of leaving the status active.

patches.title: Throwback v1.1 by Leet Sketcher
desc: Shadow steps forward and throws normally when his target has Jumped.
